ruleDefinitions.name: Use of UltraVNC Remote Access Software
ruleDefinitions.description: An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software,to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks

sequences.query: (process_description = "VNCViewer" OR process_product = "UltraVNC\ VNCViewer" OR process_company = "UltraVNC" OR process_original_file_name = "VNCViewer\.exe")
